# Generated child termination regression

These are the actual parent and child histories recovered from the first
three-case/four-root component attempt. The parent started this child at event59
with `PARENT_CLOSE_POLICY_TERMINATE`, then completed. The child terminated later
with reason `by parent close policy` and identity `history-service`. The original
oracle rejected every Terminated execution before checking this relationship.

`provenance.json` records exact history/receipt hashes and the original receipt
location. Restoring the preserved fixture may advance workflows and writes
metadata/authority; only the oracle's history fetch is read-only. The historical
receipt's broad read-only qualification is corrected here, without modifying the
original evidence. These files establish the observed policy relationship, not
an unchanged-state recovery or complete generated-workflow acceptance.
